# Landscapt & Equipt

> Landscapt & Equipt is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for landscape and snow companies. Landscapt is the CRM / field service management product (estimating, dispatch, invoicing, client relationships). Equipt is the CMMS product (asset registry, preventive maintenance, work orders, purchasing). Both share one login and one vendor database.

Landscapt runs on a real budget-engine estimating model (production rates, labor burden, overhead markup) rather than flat-rate guessing, and covers the full field-service lifecycle: clients and properties, estimates, scheduling/dispatch, invoicing and payments, snow operations, job photos, tickets, and a client portal.

Equipt covers the maintenance lifecycle for the same company's fleet and equipment: asset registry, preventive maintenance schedules, work orders, parts inventory, vendor management, and purchasing/requisitions — shared with Landscapt via the same vendor table.
